description: Na₂Ge₂ZnSe₆ crystallizes in the tetragonal I4/mcm space group. Na is bonded in a distorted square co-planar geometry to four equivalent Se atoms. All Na-Se bond lengths are 3.08 Å. Zn is bonded to four equivalent Se atoms to form distorted ZnSe₄ tetrahedra that share edges with two equivalent GeSe₄ tetrahedra. All Zn-Se bond lengths are 2.52 Å. Ge is bonded to four Se atoms to form GeSe₄ tetrahedra that share  an edgeedge with one ZnSe₄ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one GeSe₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (2.37 Å) and two longer (2.44 Å) Ge-Se bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Se sites. In the first Se site, Se is bonded in an L-shaped geometry to two equivalent Ge atoms. In the second Se site, Se is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Zn, and one Ge atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing SeNa₂ZnGe trigonal pyramids.
